headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the EVCC solar charging controller. Point it at your EVCC instance — the plugin will discover loadpoints, vehicles, and site telemetry automatically.

url.title: EVCC URL
url.description: Base URL of your EVCC instance. No trailing slash.

password.title: Admin password (optional)
password.description: Required only for settable HomeKit controls (charge limit, mode, battery mode). Leave blank for a read-only plugin.

pollInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: REST poll cadence. The websocket pushes diffs in near-real-time; this poll is the safety net when the WS drops.

loadpointMode.title: Loadpoint mode UI
loadpointMode.description: How the loadpoint exposes its mode. 'Outlet' = single on/off that toggles between off and your default mode. 'Switches' = 3 mutually-exclusive switches for full mode control. 'Read-only' = no controls.

defaultLoadpointMode.title: Default mode for the on/off outlet
defaultLoadpointMode.description: When loadpointMode = 'outlet', this is the mode the loadpoint switches to when the outlet is turned ON. Ignored otherwise.

exposeVehicleLimit.title: Also expose the assigned vehicle's charge limit
exposeVehicleLimit.description: Adds a second WindowCovering per loadpoint that drives the *vehicle's* limitSoc (follows the car wherever it plugs in). Off by default — the loadpoint limit is usually what you want.

hideSite.title: Hide site telemetry accessory
hideSite.description: Suppress the site-wide accessory (PV / grid / home battery / consumption). Loadpoints and vehicle sensors still appear.

hideVehiclePresence.title: Hide per-vehicle presence sensors
hideVehiclePresence.description: Suppress the per-vehicle OccupancySensor accessories. Useful if you only have one car and don't need a dedicated 'is plugged in' sensor.

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Log raw websocket frames and REST traffic. Leave off for normal use.
